propositions: Nested pytest child launched without --basetemp joins user-global numbered temp root and hangs during pytest session-finish cleanup after test execution completes and reports 100%.

pytest TempPathFactory synchronously scans and recursively deletes stale numbered temp trees at session close, consuming the entire 90-second child timeout when shared root contains thousands of retained entries.
Private basetemp passed via caller-owned tmp_path isolates cleanup scope and eliminates the liveness hang without changing test selection, environment, timeout, or ambient-store semantics.
Controlled A/B with poisoned 400,000-entry shared root demonstrated 12x cleanup cost difference (10.8s shared vs 0.88s private), proving cleanup cost scales with retained entries.
Nested child deleted another run's sentinel before fix, proving it was cleaning the shared root; after applying --basetemp fix, sentinel survives and regression test passes.
